physical.title: album; painting
physical.summary:
An aşçi başı; single-page painting mounted on album folio. Head cook with unshaven chin wearing a plain white Janissary headdress, dark blue kaftan with green lining, light blue sash, blue trousers and high black boots and carrying a staff of office. Inscribed. Album contains 124 paintings of Turkish sultans and court officials.
Ink and opaque watercolour on paper. Album bound in green leather with pages of Persian paper, according to inscription. Page edges gilded with gold.
